concept: A large recess carved into the pane that takes dragged files and is itself a button, lifting into chosen glass while a file is over it.

default_to_avoid.pattern: a dropzone with a dashed border and a blue tint while a file is dragged over it
default_to_avoid.kind: dropzone, drop area, drag and drop upload
default_to_avoid.why_not: a dashed border is a print idiom and a blue tint brings a hue; Pane carves a groove and lifts it into chosen glass

derivation.consequence: light falls from above, so every surface carries a rim brightest along its top edge and a soft shadow below that says where it floats, and a recess is the inverse, shaded under its top lip and lit on its bottom lip; a nested surface adds no second blur, because one sheet of glass is one layer
derivation.form: the zone is the field groove at the size of a target, shaded under its top lip and lit on its bottom lip

derivation.consequence: selected and pressed states change shape or add a mark (a check, a ring), never only colour
derivation.form: a file over the zone lifts it into chosen glass and adds a ring, so the change reads by shape as well as tone

derivation.consequence: the scene supplies the hue; the system owns no hue of its own, only white at opacities and one ink, and colour appears only where it states a status or marks a diagram
derivation.form: it brings no hue at any point; the over state is the chosen glass every other choice uses

variants.reason: A is a recess like every field (P3) and says over by shape (P6). B brings a dash and a hue. C gives a drag nowhere to land.

root.why: the zone is a large groove with centred contents and is a button for keyboard and touch

well.why: the glyph sits in a small round well carved into the groove

label.why: the main line is semibold at body size and says what to drop

hint.why: the second line is secondary at label size and says what is accepted

@media forced-colors: active.why: in forced colours the system draws the edges and marks so every part stays findable

hover.why: under the pointer the groove gains a hairline ring so the target is clear

data-over.why: while a file is over it the zone lifts into chosen glass with a ring

focus-visible.why: the focus ring shows when the zone is reached by keyboard

disabled.why: a disabled zone dims and refuses both drops and presses

aria-invalid=true.why: a wrong answer takes the critical ring a field takes, and FormField says what is wrong in words

background-color.why: the chosen glass fades in on the hover ease as a file arrives

box-shadow.why: the ring eases in with the glass so the two read as one change
